headline: Public Storage (NYSE:PSA) Beats on Core FFO, Raises Full-Year Guidance
summary: Public Storage (PSA) Q2 revenue and GAAP EPS slightly missed estimates, but Core FFO beat and full-year guidance was raised, driven by strong operations and strategic acquisitions.
